items.description:
Business Associates (Pty) Ltd is an Akasia-based business services firm covering company registration and CIPC work, from new PTY, NPC and NPO registrations to annual returns, director and address amendments, conversion of a CC to a PTY, and company deregistration or restoration. Its tax services add public officer and tax registration, tax clearance, VAT and PAYE/SDL/UIF registration and returns, and import/export customs registration.

The business also handles Workman's Compensation administration in full, including COIDA registration, letters of good standing, audit processing and payment arrangements, alongside monthly accounting, payroll and bookkeeping services and annual financial statements. For businesses needing supporting paperwork, it prepares BBBEE and CIDB documentation, CSD registration, business profiles and tender packages, and also offers website design and domain hosting. Based in The Orchards, Akasia, it suits small businesses wanting one provider for registration, compliance and ongoing accounting.

Business Registration Warehouse handles South African company registrations, starting with new private company (Pty) registrations from R599, which include name reservation, a company registration certificate and a Memorandum of Incorporation. It also registers non-profit companies from R999 (requiring a minimum of three directors), incorporated companies from R1,299 for professionals with practice numbers such as lawyers and doctors, and public companies from R2,299 for businesses wanting to offer shares to the public, whether or not they intend to list on the JSE.

For foreign businesses, it registers external companies from R2,899, covering entities already registered in another country that want a registered presence in South Africa too. Beyond new registrations, the business manages annual returns, tax clearance, VAT and trademark registration, business deregistration, and company amendments such as a director change from R499. Based in Eldorette, Pretoria, it suits entrepreneurs and foreign businesses needing straightforward, fixed-price company registration and compliance support.

C.a.T.S (Pty) Ltd is a Pretoria-based provider of Computer Assisted Telephony Systems, installing IVR systems manufactured by IBM and C3 Ltd and developing applications in VoiceXML, Java and State Tables. Its core work covers customer care, comment and opinion lines, competition lines, information lines and voicemail systems for the telecommunications sector, alongside IVR consultancy, systems integration and support.

The business is aligned with HP, C3 and Tecnomen for voice solutions, and its applications include speech recognition and text-to-speech capability built on WebSphere infrastructure. C.a.T.S and its Tanzanian subsidiary, ICMA Ltd, have both been accepted into IBM's Value Advantage Plus initiative for their WebSphere-based voice response IVR solution. Operating from Wingate Park, Pretoria, C.a.T.S suits organisations needing custom interactive voice response systems for customer service or promotional lines rather than an off-the-shelf call centre package.

Camil Suspensions manufactures a suspension system designed and built in South Africa as an alternative to replacing worn shock absorbers, aimed at improving ride stability, quality and load-carrying ability. The system is a patented suspension-supplementing design rather than a direct shock absorber replacement, fitted alongside a vehicle's existing suspension components.

The business holds SABS ISO 9002:1994 approval covering its quality systems for the manufacture and supply of shock absorbers and suspension components, and its design has also been assessed against German Bureau of Standards criteria. Based in Parktown Estate, Pretoria, Camil Suspensions suits vehicle owners, including 1-tonne LDV operators, who want to improve ride comfort and load handling without a full suspension rebuild, backed by a locally engineered, certified product rather than an imported generic part.

Capital Properties is a real estate agency based in Wonderboom South, Pretoria, with a sales and rental portfolio that, at the time of research, included 111 properties for sale and 2 to rent through its listings. The agency's coverage extends beyond Wonderboom South itself, serving areas including Pretoria, Centurion, Akasia, Soshanguve and Mabopane.

Clients can access tools such as a bond calculator and property email alerts through the agency, alongside a team of agents handling both sales and rentals. Operating from De Beer Street in Wonderboom South, Capital Properties suits buyers, sellers and landlords in the northern Pretoria area looking for a locally based agency rather than a large national franchise, with both residential sales and rental management handled under one roof.

Capitol Business Prints is a Pretoria-based printing and graphic design business established in 2002, producing business cards, flyers, indoor and outdoor banners, and vehicle wraps and decals. Public directories list the business under both printing services and graphic design, and customer enquiries about the business specifically identify it as a destination for business-card printing, alongside its broader large-format and vehicle-signage work.

Orders are not limited to walk-in customers in Sinoville: the business offers nationwide courier delivery, so businesses and individuals elsewhere in South Africa can place a printing or signage order without visiting in person. Based at 99 Sefako Makgatho Service Lane, Sinoville, Pretoria, Capitol Business Prints suits businesses and individuals needing commercial printing and graphic design work, from everyday business cards and flyers to larger banner and vehicle-wrap signage, with delivery handled beyond the local area.

Castello di Monte is a 5-star guest house in Waterkloof Ridge, built in Tuscan style on a hillside estate with views across Pretoria, tucked behind banks of olive trees and lavender. Accommodation is spread across nine elegant suites, including a Presidential Suite and a Honeymoon Suite, and guests can dine at the on-site Champère Restaurant or at the Terrace Chef's Table, which offers 360-degree views of the city.

Beyond overnight stays, the estate hosts picnics, high tea and a rooftop dinner venue, and can accommodate up to 14 people for a small conference or meeting, or an intimate wedding of up to 35 guests. Entered through rustic copper gates, Castello di Monte suits couples and small groups looking for a boutique, scenic guest house in Pretoria for a getaway, a small wedding or an intimate business gathering, rather than a large conference hotel.

Centurion Electricians Centurion is an electrical contracting business whose technicians have worked in the Centurion area long enough to know its specific electrical quirks, and who keep up to date through ongoing workshops and seminars on new techniques and technology. The business only uses qualified technicians and genuine replacement parts, rather than cheaper, unqualified labour or non-genuine parts, to keep installations fully compliant.

Work starts with a full on-site assessment of the problem, followed by a quotation based on the complexity of the job and the materials needed, before any repair work begins. The business handles domestic, commercial, industrial and medical electrical work across the Centurion area. Based in Die Hoewes, Centurion Golf Estate, Centurion Electricians Centurion suits property owners who want a qualified, locally experienced electrician for anything from a small domestic repair to a more complex industrial or medical installation.

CERadvance Engineering Ceramics is a Silvertondale-based manufacturing subcontractor supplying engineering and other technical ceramics, electro-technical ceramics and high-temperature refractories to South African and global industries. Its product range includes refractory and reformer components, electrical insulators, MACOR glass ceramics and abrasion-resistant ceramics such as cyclone components and FEROBIDE weldable tungsten carbide wear parts.

More specialised items include LINE-OX hollow spheres for catalyst beds, alumina spigots, wear sleeves, bends and reducers, ceramic boiler tube ferrules, ceramic crucibles and combustion boats, and investment casting cores, positioning the business as a specialist ceramics subcontractor rather than a general industrial supplier. Operating from Foundry Street in Silvertondale, Jan Niemand Park, CERadvance suits industrial clients needing wear-resistant or heat-resistant ceramic components manufactured to specification, from catalyst and refractory applications through to electrical insulation parts.

CH Professional Pretoria East Estate Agents, trading as Property CHiii, is an estate agency built around combining decades of industry expertise with a detailed understanding of local Pretoria East neighbourhood trends. Its team handles property sales and marketing, backed by a professional, data-driven approach to market assessments for areas such as Murrayfield, Equestria and Lynnwood Ridge.

Every property listed gets its own marketing strategy, action plan and feedback schedule, giving sellers visibility into how their property is being promoted rather than a one-size-fits-all listing. The agency also offers a free online property valuation tool for sellers wanting an initial indication of value. Based in La Montagne, Pretoria, CH Professional suits homeowners selling in Pretoria East who want a locally focused agency with a structured, transparent marketing process rather than a large national franchise.

Charl Lochner Attorneys is a family law firm in Wonderboom South handling divorce and separation matters, including contested and uncontested divorces and settlements, alongside child custody, care and contact disputes and broader guardianship matters. The practice also manages maintenance applications, amendments, arrears and enforcement for both child and spousal maintenance claims.

Further services cover domestic violence and protection orders, parenting plans and mediation support, and antenuptial contracts and related advice for couples preparing to marry. The firm positions its approach around clear, practical legal guidance given how personal and emotionally difficult family law matters can be for clients. Open Monday to Thursday from 8am to 4pm, Charl Lochner Attorneys, based in Wonderboom South, Pretoria, suits individuals and families needing dedicated family law representation rather than a general legal practice handling family matters alongside unrelated work.

items.description:
Cheekin Garsfontein serves a Middle Eastern-inspired shawarma menu from Mary Lynn Square in Garsfontein, with options including a BBQ chicken shawarma, a BBQ pulled pork shawarma, a chilli blaster shawarma and a vegetarian version made with homemade chickpea falafel. Each shawarma is rolled in homemade flatbread pita with fillings such as hummus, garlic sauce and pickled cucumber, alongside a signature BBQ sauce used across several dishes.

Beyond shawarmas, the menu covers gozleme, loaded chips in regular and large rustic-cut servings with a choice of toppings, chicken strip wraps, sides, salads, bowls and sweets, plus a range of sauces and drinks. Orders can be placed through the restaurant's own online ordering page. Based at Mary Lynn Square, Garsfontein, Cheekin suits customers looking for a casual, flavour-forward shawarma and Middle Eastern-style takeaway rather than a sit-down restaurant.

Christine van Wyk Tours has operated guided tours for South African travellers for 45 years, continuing into its 2027 touring season from its base in Florauna, Pretoria. Its upcoming itineraries include an Amsterdam, Rhine cruise and Black Forest tour in April 2027, a longer version of the same route extended into Switzerland from late April to mid-May 2027, and a Belgium tour timed around André Rieu's concerts, with an optional Rhône river cruise in France, in July 2027.

A Danube river cruise combined with a European Christmas tour is planned for December 2027, reflecting the operator's focus on European coach and river-cruise touring rather than beach or safari holidays. Open Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm, Christine van Wyk Tours suits South African travellers who prefer a long-established, guided group tour to Europe over planning an independent overseas trip themselves.

A current directory lists the business at 7 Vindhella Road, Valhalla (phone, domain cleanpowerafrica.co.za), but the company's own site could not be reached, so the specific solar/wind/wave/monitoring service claims remain unverified; hold.

Deeper research found only the business's own PretoriaHub listing (186 Bokser Street, Hesteapark/Akasia), confirming carpet, rug, upholstery and window cleaning already known; no further detail on service area, pricing or booking found; hold, nothing new to add.

items.description:
Clubview Storage is a self-storage facility in Clubview Ext 120, Centurion, offering units in five sizes, 15, 16, 18, 21 and 24 square metres, each with a 3-metre-high ceiling to allow for stacking. Unit sizes are pitched at specific household moves, from the contents of a two-bedroom home up to a five-bedroom household, as well as vehicle storage for SUVs, bakkies and caravans, with shaded vehicle parking also available on site.

Security is built around facial-recognition biometric access alongside 24-hour surveillance, and the facility operates normal daytime access hours, with after-hours entry available by prior arrangement. Based at 199 Jean Avenue, Clubview Ext 120, Centurion, on the corner of Ryker and Jean, Clubview Storage suits households needing to store furniture during a move or renovation, as well as vehicle owners looking for secure, monitored parking rather than open-air storage.

CMT Engineering operates in the water and electrical reticulation industry, offering turnkey HT and LT electrical services, borehole testing and water treatment plants, environmental solutions, and mobile diesel pumps and generators for mining, commercial, community and domestic clients. The business sources its products from reputable international suppliers, passing on manufacturer guarantees and warranties to clients.

Its client list spans major mining operations, including Sibanye Stillwater and Goldfields since 2012, Jaguar Mining in Brazil since 2017, Circum Minerals in Ethiopia's Danakil Desert from 2016 to 2017, and Debswana in Orapa, Botswana since 2019, reflecting established relationships with industry project leaders across several countries. Based in Moregloed, Pretoria, CMT Engineering suits mining and industrial clients needing turnkey water and electrical reticulation solutions from a contractor with a multi-year track record on large sites.

Control Systems Integration (Pty) Ltd is an industrial automation and systems integration company founded in 2005, working across instrumentation, PLC and SCADA programming, and manufacturing execution (MES/MOM) systems. Its services extend to condition monitoring, intelligent dashboards and industrial data infrastructure, alongside integrated electrical and control system design and broader industrial operations consulting.

The company operates across Southern Africa rather than a single city, serving continuous-process and manufacturing businesses that need their plant instrumentation, control systems and data reporting to work together rather than as separate add-ons. Based at Unit 14, Diamond Park, 70 Jakaranda Street, Hennopspark Ext 16, Centurion, Control Systems Integration suits manufacturing and process-industry operators looking for a single provider to design, program and maintain the automation and control systems running their production lines.

Cosy Inn is a fully equipped, load-shedding-free self-catering apartment in Clubview, Centurion, situated next to the owner's home on a quiet, tree-lined street with its own private entrance. The unit is around 3km from Netcare Unitas Hospital and close to shops, restaurants, the Klein Kaap Hotel, Akademia and SuperSport Park, with easy access to the Gautrain station and main roads.

The apartment sleeps two guests in a bedroom furnished with a king-size bed that can be converted into two single beds on request, and offers free cancellation up to a week before a stay, with check-in between 3pm and 8pm and check-out at 10am. With a 4.9 rating from 37 reviews, Cosy Inn, at 201 Constance Avenue in Clubview East, suits travellers wanting a small, well-located self-catering stay with guaranteed power rather than a larger hotel.

CoverTech SA designs and manufactures the Premium Golf Cart Shelter, a freestanding, fully enclosed golf cart garage built with a powder-coated aluminium frame and PVC canvas roof that needs no concrete or building work to install. The shelters are designed and manufactured in Pretoria and can be installed without tools and moved if needed, built to withstand South African sun, rain and wind.

The single-bay shelter, for one golf cart, starts from R18,999, while a double-bay version protecting two carts side by side under a shared roof starts from R32,999, aimed at golf estates, retirement villages and private residences. CoverTech SA also designs bespoke configurations with extra bays or custom dimensions to suit a specific site. Based in Magalieskruin, Pretoria, the business suits golf cart owners wanting weatherproof cover without the cost or permitting of a permanent garage.

CPRD Consulting is a psychological consultancy that has worked in psychomotor and psychometric assessment and research since 1995. Using the Vienna Test System, a computer-based assessment platform, the consultancy profiles candidates through psychometric and psychomotor testing, with assessments carried out either at its own offices or on site at a client's premises, depending on what the organisation needs.

The consultancy works with organisations that want objective assessment data behind their recruitment and other occupational decisions, rather than relying on interviews and CVs alone, with the aim of helping companies make better hiring decisions. Based at Berkley Office Park, Bauhinia Street, Highveld Techno Park, Centurion, CPRD Consulting suits employers wanting psychometric or psychomotor testing built into their recruitment or placement process, backed by assessment methods it has applied since the mid-1990s.

CSpa Wellness by Camelot at The Blyde is one branch of the countrywide Camelot Wellness group, operating from The Blyde lifestyle centre on Bronkhorstspruit Road in Pretoria East. As with CSpa Wellness branches generally, this location does not include spa facilities such as saunas or steam rooms, which vary by property, so its focus stays on treatment-based services rather than a full spa-day facility.

Being part of a larger franchise group gives the branch access to a shared booking system and brand standards used at CSpa Wellness locations across Gauteng, including sister branches in Waterfall, Linbro Park and Kyalami. The Blyde branch is open daily from 9am to 6pm, including Sundays and public holidays. Based in Blyde Riverwalk Estate, Pretoria, it suits clients wanting a treatment-focused day spa visit without needing a full spa-facility experience.

cStream designs its offerings around the full lifecycle of a product, from initial concept through to retirement, supplying professional services such as integration, design, training, implementation and product supply rather than hardware alone. Its range of products and services is built for demanding environments involving shock, vibration, moisture and temperature extremes, making it well suited to military, mining and industrial applications.

The business is fully BBBEE compliant and works with a network of partners including Airnesco, CJ Components, Finitron, Mildef, RolaTube, Satel, Steiner and Zebra, alongside its own cStream Maintenance, Support, Customisation and Product Development services. Based in Centurion Central, cStream suits organisations operating ruggedised equipment or private radio networks in harsh conditions who need a long-term technical partner for both the original product and its ongoing support, rather than a one-off equipment supplier.

Culture Club is a bar and tapas restaurant in Hazelwood built around a shared-plates style of eating rather than a single national cuisine, drawing on Mediterranean, Middle Eastern, Asian and local flavours. Its food menu runs from dips, spreads and nibbles to salads, vegetables, mixed plates, share boards and sweet tapas, designed for ordering a variety of dishes to share across the table.

The cocktail list runs from classics such as a Cosmopolitan, Negroni and Long Island Iced Tea to fruit-forward options like a watermelon and cranberry mojito and a peach bellini, alongside a wine list covering sparkling MCC, white and red blends, and single varietals such as Sauvignon Blanc, Chardonnay, Pinotage and Shiraz. Open Monday to Saturday until midnight and Sundays until 10pm, Culture Club suits groups wanting a social, share-plates meal with cocktails rather than a traditional sit-down dinner.

D-Link Southern Africa is the local distributor of D-Link networking products, positioning itself as a provider of quality, reliable WiFi and wired products backed by local support for home users, businesses and service providers. Its current range spans home internet routers and mesh WiFi systems, range extenders and access points, mobile routers, powerline adapters, and smart managed and gigabit switches.

The distributor also supplies surveillance products such as home IP cameras and CCTV systems, alongside smart home devices, and newer products including a 5G Mi-Fi router, a 5G CPE unit and an AX3000 Wi-Fi 6 router. Technical support is available by phone Monday to Friday from 8am to 8:30pm and weekends from 9am to 6pm. Operating from Highveld Techno Park in Eco Park, Centurion, D-Link Southern Africa suits South African customers needing local stock and support rather than importing networking equipment directly.

Damilight is a financial and management consulting firm in Centurion built around helping companies and organisations achieve their financial goals through tailored growth strategies. Its services span strategy consulting and advisory, finance, accounting and tax work including bookkeeping, financial reporting, tax planning and audit readiness, and financial planning and wealth management covering wills, trusts, estate planning, life cover, retirement annuities and investment options.

The firm also offers research services that turn data into clear business strategies, and IT-related digital transformation support for clients wanting to modernise their operations. That combination lets Damilight serve both the financial and the operational side of a growing business from one firm. Open Monday to Friday from 8am to 4:30pm and based in The Reeds, Centurion, Damilight suits startups and SMEs that want strategy, financial and technology advice from a single consultancy rather than separate specialists.

DCC Projects and Developments is an Irene, Centurion firm whose team brings a combined total of more than 90 years of experience across construction, tendering and compliance disciplines. Its construction project work focuses on completing projects to a high standard of quality within budget and on schedule, while its tender services help clients prepare and review bid documents to ensure they meet a client's submission requirements.

The business also provides SHEQ (safety, health, environment and quality) services, and takes on renovation and general building work alongside its project management role. Its stated focus throughout is reducing risk exposure for clients while keeping projects on time and on budget. Based at Main Road, Irene, Centurion, DCC Projects and Developments suits clients needing experienced project management and tender support for construction work, rather than a single-trade building contractor.

Delutch Designs is a Hazeldean-based design and manufacturing business built around a single design and manufacturing hub covering the full product development lifecycle. Its stated vision is to become a leading African design company that elevates clients' market reach and brand perception, with a mission to take customers from initial concept through to a manufactured final product or service.

That full-chain approach covers graphic design, logo creation and brand development alongside product conceptualisation and physical manufacturing, rather than handing a finished design over to a separate manufacturer. Based in Hazeldean, Pretoria, Delutch Designs suits businesses that want their branding and a physical product developed and produced by the same team, from an early concept sketch through to a manufactured item ready to sell.

items.reason: Confirmed as a general contractor via government procurement bid documentation, and the 52 Panorama Road, Rooihuiskraal address matches, but the specific residential construction/renovation/pool/boundary-wall service list in the existing text could not be independently verified beyond the general-contractor classification; too thin, hold.

items.description:
Digalance, trading as The Digital Alliance, works with businesses on digital transformation journeys, addressing challenges such as rapid business evolution, immature IT processes, multi-vendor environments and inefficient IT investment. Its approach centres on a Business Services Cloud concept with self-healing capabilities, using automation and orchestration so systems can manage and resolve some issues autonomously rather than needing constant manual intervention.

Transformation projects follow a roadmap that includes an assessment of current digital capabilities, a realistic implementation timeline, and delivery across cloud computing, cybersecurity, microservices and API integration, carried out by a team of digital strategists, IT specialists and data scientists. Based in Midstream Estate, Centurion, Digalance suits organisations whose IT environment has grown into duplicate, fragmented or under-used applications and need a structured plan to consolidate and modernise it rather than adding another point solution.

Diri Aluminium (Pty) Ltd was established in 1976 and has built its reputation on the design, manufacture and installation of architectural aluminium products to industry-leading standards. The business works to achieve each customer's specific design vision, backed by decades of accumulated experience alongside newer technology and systems as they become available.

Diri Aluminium is a member of the Association of Architectural Aluminium Manufacturers of South Africa (AAAMSA) and the Master Builders Association North, giving it formal standing within the architectural aluminium and construction industries. Operating from Sunderland Ridge, Centurion, Diri Aluminium suits architects, builders and property developers needing an established, industry-accredited manufacturer for aluminium windows, doors and architectural glazing on commercial or residential projects, rather than a newer, unaccredited supplier.

Dr Bertus van Niekerk is a specialist orthodontist practising from private rooms in Lynnwood, Pretoria, with an additional satellite office in Witbank. His practice covers the placement of braces, clear aligners and orthodontic retainers, along with minimally invasive mini-implant corrective jaw procedures for patients needing more complex bite correction.

Before deciding on a treatment or surgical plan, Dr van Niekerk evaluates each patient's gum and oral health alongside their bite, taking a full medical history and any previous orthodontic or dental work into account. Consultations typically address concerns such as malocclusion, or a "bad bite," as well as general dental aesthetics. Based at Xcel Park in Lynnwood, Dr Bertus van Niekerk Orthodontist suits children, adolescents and adults needing specialist orthodontic treatment, from standard braces through to more involved corrective jaw procedures, rather than general dental care.

Dr Esre Struwig is a general practitioner running an independent GP practice in Pierre van Ryneveld Park, Centurion. She qualified with an MBChB from the University of Pretoria in 2007 and provides general medical consultations from her own practice rather than as part of a larger multi-doctor clinic.

The practice consults Monday to Friday from 7:30am to 5:30pm, with Saturday appointments available by prior arrangement, giving patients access outside standard single-day working hours. Based at 72 Van Ryneveld Avenue, Pierre van Ryneveld Park, Centurion, Dr Esre Struwig's practice suits patients in the Centurion area looking for an established, locally based GP for everyday medical consultations and ongoing care.

Dreamy Comfort is an online-only furniture and homeware retailer based in Mayville, Pretoria, built around keeping its business model efficient so it can offer stylish furniture at competitive prices rather than charging for the overheads of a physical showroom. Its collections include sofas and recliners in one, two and three-seater and corner or modular configurations, foam and spring mattress and bed sets, headboards and lounge suites.

The range also extends to sleeper couches, TV units, coffee tables, nightstands and pedestals, along with camping and outdoor furniture and household plasticware, covering bedrooms, lounges and outdoor spaces from one store. Dreamy Comfort positions itself for customers furnishing a first home, refreshing a single room, or upgrading an office, rather than only large full-home furniture buyers. Operating from Paul Kruger Street in Mayville, it suits budget-conscious shoppers wanting style and comfort without visiting a physical furniture showroom.

Dycer Foundry and Engineering provides end-to-end manufacturing under one roof, combining an in-house ferrous and non-ferrous foundry for precision casting, CNC machining for high-tolerance milling and turning, structural fabrication and welding, and CAD-based design and drafting. Keeping these stages in-house, rather than outsourcing critical steps to separate suppliers, is central to how the business controls quality and lead times on each job.

That integrated setup is aimed at eliminating supply-chain bottlenecks between casting, machining and fabrication, backed by what the business describes as decades of combined engineering experience among its staff and a 4.8 out of 5 average client rating. Operating from Waltloo, Pretoria, and open Monday to Thursday from 7am to 4pm and Fridays from 7am to 1:10pm, Dycer Foundry and Engineering suits industrial clients needing complex components taken from concept through casting, machining and fabrication to a finished part.

Dynamics Mobile Trailers, owned by Dynamics Holdings, is a South African manufacturer of purpose-built mobile trailers covering a wide range of uses rather than a single trailer type. Its range includes fully equipped mobile kitchens for food vending, catering and street food, mobile stages for concerts, festivals and outdoor events, and animal trailers for the safe transport of livestock, pets and farm animals.

The business also builds camping trailers for travel and outdoor use, and hearse trailers designed for the dignified transport of coffins during funeral services. Dynamics Mobile Trailers works across industrial, commercial and residential customers in both the private and public sectors, building its reputation on honesty, reliability and consistent quality. Based in Kameeldrift, Pretoria, the business suits anyone needing a custom-built mobile trailer for a specific commercial or personal use rather than a standard off-the-shelf trailer.

Easylife Kitchens Faerie Glen is a showroom within the wider Easylife Kitchens network, offering bespoke kitchen design and custom cabinetry beyond just kitchens, including fitted cupboards, bathroom vanities, bars, studies, TV cabinets and bookshelves. In the showroom, design consultations cover layout, material and finish choices before any installation work begins.

As a registered member of the Kitchen Specialists Association, the business backs its work with a two-year guarantee on its products and a lifetime guarantee on hinges and runners. Based at Unit 1B, Boardwalk Lakeside, Boardwalk Office Park, 107 Haymeadow Crescent, Faerie Glen, Pretoria, Easylife Kitchens Faerie Glen serves homeowners across Faerie Glen, Pretoria East, Waterkloof and the surrounding upmarket areas who want custom-built cabinetry designed around their own space rather than off-the-shelf units.

items.description:
EliteWell Dynamics is a health and wellness transformation centre built on nearly four decades of experience in the health industry, offering science-backed, non-invasive therapies aimed at helping the body recover, detox and function better naturally. The business is explicit that it does not sell supplements or gym memberships, positioning its approach instead as a broader wellness transformation supported by an in-house research and development team.

For the past 18 years, EliteWell Dynamics has also run as a franchise, helping South Africans build an income around wellness while offering comprehensive business and training support to franchisees, including initial training to get new operators up to speed. Based in Annlin, Pretoria, the business suits both clients seeking non-invasive wellness therapy and entrepreneurs looking to run a wellness-focused franchise rather than start an unrelated business from scratch.

Elton Cranes is a Pretoria-based crane-hire company providing mobile cranes and lifting solutions for construction and other medium- to large-scale projects. The business was profiled in South African Builder magazine in July 2024, when it was then around three months old and running a 25-ton crane mounted on its own truck chassis.

Its team includes qualified riggers, crane operators, mechanics, technical staff and project-management staff, and the business handles the repair, maintenance and servicing of its own cranes, vehicles and equipment in-house rather than outsourcing upkeep. Based in Hesteapark, Pretoria, Elton Cranes suits construction companies and other project teams needing mobile crane hire backed by an in-house maintenance operation rather than a purely rental-only provider.

Embrac'n Touch Wellness & Spa is a day spa in Theresapark offering a focused range of massage styles, including Balinese, hot stone, Swedish and a fire and ice full body massage, alongside reflexology, facial treatments and foot ritual therapy. Appointments can be booked by phone or through an online booking and enquiry form.

Beyond standalone treatments, the spa puts together packaged experiences for occasions such as a couple's retreat, a birthday combo, a baby shower, a self-care spring day, a foot ritual group session, and year-end functions, as well as Mother's Day and Father's Day specials. Based on Barbara Street in Theresapark, Embrac'n Touch suits both individuals wanting a specific massage or treatment and groups looking to book a themed spa occasion together rather than a single standard treatment.

Embriant Software (Pty) Ltd is a Pretoria-based business software development company, historically associated with software built for financial and transaction-related environments. Current directories classify the business under computer software and services, reflecting a broader custom-development focus rather than a single product line.

Among its products, Embriant Software is the company behind Dog Breeder Pro, a software service built for dog breeders, confirmed through Dog Breeder Pro's own privacy policy, which names Embriant Software (Pty) Ltd at its Koedoespoort Industrial address. Based at 33 Eland Street, Koedoespoort Industrial, Pretoria, Embriant Software suits businesses needing custom software development, alongside niche customers such as dog breeders using its own packaged Dog Breeder Pro product.

items.description:
Engen Hazeldean Convenience Centre is a 24-hour petrol station in Hazeldean, Pretoria East, also listed as a diesel and fuel supplier and an oil change service, alongside general petroleum products. Its round-the-clock hours mean fuel and basic vehicle servicing are available regardless of time of day, which sets it apart from stations that close overnight.

The station sits among a cluster of other Engen sites in the area, including nearby stations in Equestria and Faerie Glen, giving motorists in Pretoria East several Engen options along the same general route. Located on Silver Lakes Road in Hazeldean, Engen Hazeldean Convenience Centre suits drivers needing fuel, an oil change or basic vehicle servicing at any hour, rather than only during standard trading hours.

items.reason: LinkedIn gives Envine Solutions' address as Limeroc Business Park, Stand 6, Peach Tree, Knoppieslaagte, Centurion, not the supplied Icon Industrial Park, Kwanbi Crescent, Sunderland Ridge address; hold until the address is verified.

EPI-USE Africa is part of EPI-USE, which describes itself as the world's largest and most experienced independent SAP HR and Payroll specialist, part of the wider Group Elephant network of more than 4,200 employees across a 42-year track record. The group operates as ten trading brands across 42 countries, serving more than 2,000 of the world's largest corporations and public sector agencies and licensing software to more than 1,800 organisations worldwide.

EPI-USE's services span SAP HR and Payroll system design, implementation and cloud migration, supported by a strategic collaboration with AWS for cloud migrations and a recent equity partnership with a global payroll consultancy to expand its boardroom advisory and transformation work. The group has also won the SAP Global HCM Partner Excellence Award for delivery quality in consecutive years. Operating an AppHaus in Pretoria, within Alphen Park, EPI-USE Africa suits large organisations needing SAP HR and payroll expertise backed by international scale.

Express Business Capital is a Groenkloof-based financial company providing small business funding to South African SMEs, structured as a cash advance against a business's future turnover rather than a conventional fixed-term loan. This model is aimed at businesses that have reached a point where they can no longer fund growth from their own cash flow, but may not qualify easily for a traditional bank loan.

The company positions its merchant cash advance product as a simpler, more convenient alternative to standard unsecured business lending, with an emphasis on an easy-to-understand, user-friendly application and repayment process. Open Monday to Friday from 8:30am to 4:30pm, Express Business Capital, based on George Storrar Drive in Bryntirion, Groenkloof, suits small business owners who need working capital quickly and want repayments linked to turnover rather than a fixed monthly instalment.

FAW Pretoria, Rosslyn, trading as BB FAW Rosslyn, is an authorised FAW truck dealership offering a range of light, medium and heavy-duty trucks built for the logistics, construction and agricultural sectors. Its range covers freight carriers, tippers, concrete mixers and truck tractors, with specific models running from the 2.5-tonne 4.110 FL-MT up to larger 8-tonne and heavier configurations.

FAW positions its trucks around fuel efficiency, low maintenance costs and durability engineered for South African road and site conditions, backed by the dealership's own service and parts department and after-sales support. As part of the BB Group, FAW Pretoria Rosslyn also offers finance options and used FAW vehicles alongside new models. Based in Rosslyn, Akasia, the dealership suits transport, construction and agricultural operators needing a dependable, locally supported truck rather than importing or buying unsupported used stock.
